description: Qwen3-0.6B batch-1 decode: where the decoder-block kernels come from, with the kernels an Auto-Tuner session prepared. TensorRT's own kernels (static_v3 + CUDA graphs), the hand-written fused blocks, and the same five blocks with the kernels PR 4914's KernelGenerator wrote in that session (run with TORCHTRT_KERNEL_CACHE set to the session's kernel cache and TORCH_TENSORRT_REGION_GENERATION=0, so that every build loads them and none is generated), against the default build and the best Inductor setup
